item.title: Gold and Silver Crash After Record Highs: MCX Prices Sink, Profit Booking Spooks Markets Ahead of Budget 2026
item.description: Gold and silver prices witnessed a sharp correction after touching record highs, with MCX futures crashing heavily. Profit booking, a stronger US dollar, and budget-related caution triggered volatility, raising questions about whether gold can recover next week.

item.title: Cuba Slips Deeper Into Crisis: Blackouts, Fuel Shortages and Rising Prices Push Citizens Into Survival Mode
item.description: Cuba is facing a deepening economic and humanitarian crisis as fuel shortages, daily blackouts, and soaring prices disrupt life in Havana and beyond. With pressure mounting from abroad, ordinary Cubans are struggling to meet basic needs.

item.title: Nirmala Sitharaman stuns in maroon Kanjivaram saree ahead of Budget 2026; Highlights Indian handloom
item.description: Ahead of Budget 2026-27, Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman appeared in a maroon handwoven Kanjivaram silk saree, showcasing Tamil Nadu’s traditional craftsmanship. Featuring subtle golden-brown checks and a coffee-brown border, her saree symbolizes Indian culture, self-reliance, and support for local artisans.

item.title: LPG cylinder price hike ahead of Budget 2026; Check latest rates here
item.description: Ahead of Budget 2026, the government has increased the price of 19kg commercial LPG cylinders by ₹50, affecting hotels, restaurants, and other businesses. Major cities like Delhi, Kolkata, Mumbai, and Chennai saw price hikes, while 14kg domestic cylinders remain at previous rates fixed in April 2025.

item.title: Hyundai Motor India Hits All-Time High Sales in January 2026, Driven by Strong Domestic Demand and Exports
item.description: Hyundai Motor India posted its highest-ever monthly sales in January 2026, led by record domestic volumes and sharp export growth. Strong performances by VENUE and AURA models reinforced Hyundai’s leadership in India’s competitive auto market.

item.title: Union Budget 2026: Top stocks likely to benefit, Which shares could see a boost?
item.description: Ahead of Union Budget 2026-27, investors are closely watching the stock market for potential opportunities. Key sectors likely to benefit include automobile, electric vehicles, railway, and pharmaceutical companies.

item.title: Good News for Government ahead of Budget 2026, GST revenue hits Rs 1.93 lakh crore
item.description: Ahead of Budget 2026, India’s GST collection in January 2026 rose 6.2% to ₹1.93 lakh crore, driven by strong domestic activity and import revenue growth. Net GST revenue reached ₹1.70 lakh crore.

item.title: Nirmala Sitharaman highlights 3 key duties of Government in her Budget speech; Here’s what she said
item.description: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman presented the Union Budget 2026-27, highlighting three key duties of the government: accelerate economic growth, fulfill citizens’ aspirations, and ensure inclusive development.

item.title: Union Budget 2026: India to get 7 high-speed Rail Corridors, FM Nirmala Sitharaman announces
item.description: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman announced the creation of seven new high-speed rail corridors in Budget 2026, connecting major cities like Pune, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Delhi, and Varanasi.

item.title: Union Budget 2026: Income Tax filing to become easier; New IT Act to come into effect from 1 April
item.description: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman, in Union Budget 2026-27, announced a new IT Act effective from April 1, 2026, aimed at simplifying tax compliance. Key reforms include minor tax offenses payable via penalties, foreign assets under ₹20 lakh not required to be disclosed, revised returns filing by July 31, and reduced litigation.
